newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPANISH FAN SENDS REFEREE OFF WITH RED CAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPANISH FAN SENDS REFEREE OFF WITH RED CAN.

text.p: A Spanish soccer fan, angered by refereeing decisions in Sunday's first division match between Sevilla and Logrones, ran on to the pitch and showed all three match officials a red soft drinks can squashed into the shape of a red card.
Sevilla had two players sent off in the match and lost 4-1.
Afterwards, police had to intervene to stop the crowd throwing objects at the referee and linesmen and to prevent a massed charge against the presidential box.
